|lore=Mennotor DAS-430 electromagnetic projectile launcher. Often mistaken for a blaster rifle. Fires small hollow darts filled with neurotoxin which cause temporary paralysis.
|game_text=Use 1 Force to deploy on a bounty hunter (free on IG-88). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured (and opponent loses 2 Force if target is a [Maintenance] or [[Permanent Weapon]] character) if destiny +1 > defense value.
|errata_history=* '''Original''' ([[IG-88's Neural Inhibitor (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 41 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Deploy on any bounty hunter for 1 Force (free on IG-88). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny +1 > defense value. If a card with a maintenance cost or permanent weapon is captured, opponent must lose 2 Force.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•41” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-41-IG_88s_Neural_Inhibitor-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''Errata (2006)''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 41), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Use 1 Force to deploy on a bounty hunter (free on IG-88). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured (and opponent loses 2 Force if target is a [Maintenance] or [[Permanent Weapon]] character) if destiny +1 > defense value.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here).

Slip image and game text from this sheet.
